camel_example: aliyun rds ModifyDBInstancePayType --region cn-hangzhou --DBInstanceId 'rm-bp0000' --Period Year --PayType Prepaid
description_en: Changes the billing method of an instance from pay-as-you-go to subscription
description_zh: 将按量付费的数据库实例变更为包年包月计费模式
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-db-instance-pay-type --db-instance-id rm-bp0000 --pay-type Prepaid --period Year --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBInstancePayType

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the instance. Valid values:

If you set the Period parameter to Year, the value of the UsedTime parameter ranges from 1 to 5.
If you set the Period parameter to Month, the value of the UsedTime parameter ranges from 1 to 11
parameters.help_zh:
购买时长：
包年模式，即Period取值为Year时：取值为1~5。
包月模式，即Period取值为Month时：取值为1~11
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en: The billing method of the instance. The value is fixed as Prepaid, which indicates the subscription billing method
parameters.help_zh: 付费类型，固定配置为Prepaid，表示包年包月
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The renewal cycle of the instance.

Year
Month
parameters.help_zh:
包年包月的周期：
Year：包年。
Month：包月
parameters.name: period
